questions.q: Your winger is wide and the eights are high. Drag the left fullback into a lane nobody holds.
options: Behind the six, near the center backs
questions.explain: Yes. Beside the six, the fullback becomes a second helper without copying the winger's lane.
choiceExplanations: The winger already holds the outside lane, so the fullback just duplicates his job.
